title: w1x-batch: batch-size invariance of the CIS-2 witness (C++/CUDA port --batch N) on CPU and the hq GPU

summary: hq (host C): per-row witness digest identical at batch sizes 1, 2, 4 and 8 on the host build and on the CUDA sm_61 build; batch-1 row = pinned d8274305; 4-prompt set: each row equals its solo digest on both builds (pset 4/4 host, 4/4 CUDA). Scope: replica-interleaved batching in the C++ port (the forward runs rows interleaved, not a fused batched GEMM); w2 (host D, host build only) row still queued as supplementary evidence; the fused-GEMM variant is a separate registration (w1x-batch-fused).
